analysis_source: Nepal Flood WASH Severity Analysis - Master Data
notes: Official model weights: P1 50%, P2 30%, P3 20%.
P2 is a broader Current WASH Conditions pillar covering water access/service continuity, water quality/safety and sanitation/hygiene.
Final severity classes: Very High >3.5; High 3.0–3.5; Moderate 2.25–<3.0; Low 1.75–<2.25; Minimal <1.75.
Context fields for children and households in hard-hit areas come from the response 'Total Affected' compilation where available.
The public Water Systems dashboard contains an explicitly approved, publication-safe PDNA90 point extract; private operational/contact fields remain non-public.
Analytical-framework sources are documented in data/source_registry.json and displayed in Methodology & Sources.
Current PDNA evidence is based on the 90-scheme corrections dataset dated 9 Oct 2026; ten municipalities have direct or limited PDNA evidence.
PDNA reconstruction cost uses corrected w9.reconstructionCost (Excel column GR).
pdna_publication: Publication-safe scheme extract includes approved assessment coordinates and analytical fields; assessor/contact fields are excluded.
